user.description: Link a Midea Smart AC unit to its device tracker (for example from your router integration). Whenever the tracker reports a new IP address, the unit's Midea Smart AC entry is pointed at it and reloaded.

error.no_mac: This device tracker has no MAC address, so the unit can't be identified. Pick a tracker from a router or network integration.
error.unknown_midea_entry: That Midea Smart AC entry no longer exists.

abort.already_configured: This device tracker is already linked to a unit.
abort.no_midea_entries: Add your units with Midea Smart AC first, then link them here.
